title: Stop cannot brake an Error-status session that still has a pending delegation or test-run wait
outcome: From the round-3 review of w-f917452faa71 (Claude delegation-8250851e, Low). The idle-wait Stop (src/session_stop_idle_wait.rs, Brake mode) and the UI's canStopWaitingSession require status Idle. delegation_wait_parent_eligibility_locked does not exclude Error-status parents, so a session that ended its turn in Error (for example after an Engram checkpoint failure) with a pending wait is still resumed automatically while Stop answers 409. Fix direction: allow the brake for Error sessions not in dedicated cleanup, in both the backend and the UI, or document the gap.
acceptance: Stop cannot brake an Error-status session that still has a pending delegation or test-run wait is done
